card.name: Just before stem cell transplant wording
card.fires_on: Words right before a stem cell or bone marrow transplant term, such as 'for', 'after', 'autologous', 'allogeneic' or 'auto-H'. It appears in transplant and conditioning-regimen settings.

modes.label: Linking word before transplant
modes.description: A small word like 'for' or 'after' that leads into a stem cell or marrow transplant phrase.
modes.example: A cytoreductive regimen in preparation<< for>> bone marrow transplantation that consists of cyclo

modes.label: Transplant type word
modes.description: Part of 'autologous' or 'allogeneic', or 'auto-HSCT', just before the word stem or HSCT.
modes.example: Eligible for Autolog<<ous>> Stem Cell Transplant (ASCT)

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word 'stem' next, as in 'stem cell'.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'stem cell transplant'.
